60: ' Next number like Q-2026-0105, SO-2026-0205 or RMA-2026-0012
61: Public Function NextNumber(ByVal prefix As String) As String
62:     Dim tbl As String, fld As String, stem As String, n As Variant
63:     Select Case prefix
64:     Case "Q": tbl = "Quotes": fld = "QuoteNumber"
65:     Case "RMA": tbl = "RMAs": fld = "RMANumber"
66:     Case Else: tbl = "Orders": fld = "OrderNumber"
67:     End Select
68:     stem = prefix & "-" & Year(Date) & "-"
69:     n = DMax("Val(Mid(" & fld & "," & Len(stem) + 1 & "))", tbl, fld & " Like '" & stem & "*'")
70:     NextNumber = stem & Format(Nz(n, 0) + 1, "0000")
71: End Function

144: ' Copy a quote and its lines into a new sales order
145: Public Function QuoteToOrder(frm As Form)
146:     If frm.Dirty Then frm.Dirty = False
147:     If IsNull(frm!QuoteID) Then Exit Function
148:     Dim qid As Long, oid As Variant, num As String, db As DAO.Database
149:     qid = frm!QuoteID
150:     oid = DLookup("OrderID", "Orders", "QuoteID=" & qid)
151:     If Not IsNull(oid) Then
152:         If MsgBox("Order " & DLookup("OrderNumber", "Orders", "OrderID=" & oid) & _
153:                   " was already created from this quote. Open it?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Cairn Systems") = vbYes Then
154:             DoCmd.OpenForm "frmOrders", WhereCondition:="OrderID=" & oid
155:         End If
156:         Exit Function
157:     End If
158:     If DCount("*", "QuoteLines", "QuoteID=" & qid) = 0 Then
159:         MsgBox "This quote has no line items.", vbExclamation, "Cairn Systems"
160:         Exit Function
161:     End If
162:     If MsgBox("Create a sales order from quote " & frm!QuoteNumber & "?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Cairn Systems") <> vbYes Then Exit Function
163: 
164:     Set db = CurrentDb
165:     num = NextNumber("SO")
166:     db.Execute "INSERT INTO Orders (OrderNumber, CustomerID, ContactID, RepID, QuoteID, OrderDate, OrderStatus, TaxRate, ShippingCost) " & _
167:                "SELECT '" & num & "', CustomerID, ContactID, RepID, QuoteID, Date(), 'Open', TaxRate, ShippingCost " & _
168:                "FROM Quotes WHERE QuoteID=" & qid, dbFailOnError
169:     oid = DLookup("OrderID", "Orders", "OrderNumber='" & num & "'")
170:     db.Execute "INSERT INTO OrderLines (OrderID, ProductID, LineDescription, Quantity, UnitPrice, DiscountPct) " & _
171:                "SELECT " & oid & ", ProductID, LineDescription, Quantity, UnitPrice, DiscountPct " & _
172:                "FROM QuoteLines WHERE QuoteID=" & qid & " ORDER BY QuoteLineID", dbFailOnError
173:     frm!QuoteStatus = "Accepted"
174:     frm.Dirty = False
175:     DoCmd.OpenForm "frmOrders", WhereCondition:="OrderID=" & oid
176: End Function
